_comment: DESKTOP-ARCADE (2P stand-up): keys AmPanel turns into other keys while a given program is in front (src/panel/KeyRemap.cs). The foot pedals send F13 / F14 / F15 (tools/Set-FootSwitch.ps1) so they never clash with the panel; the PS3 Time Crisis games (RPCS3, started through the old frontend's AutoHotkey programs) still wait for A (cover, held) and C (duck), so only there the pedals become A and C. 'process' is a pattern on the program's name.
